cells.label: first open
cells.note: styled chevron is a CSS border-rotate + open bg via color-mix(primary 10%); Bootstrap uses an SVG-mask chevron + --bs-accordion-active-bg/-active-color tokens

cells.label: default
cells.note: Bootstrap divider is the --bs-breadcrumb-divider var (default "/") on ::before; styled hardcodes "/" — same glyph, but no divider-override token

cells.label: brand only
cells.note: styled Navbar is a bare flex shell: padding 0.5rem 1rem vs Bootstrap 0.5rem 0; NavbarBrand has no py/margin-right vs Bootstrap brand py 0.3125rem + mr 1rem. No expand/toggler/container/NavbarNav.

cells.label: dark
cells.note: color variant maps (bg-dark ≈ variant="dark"); remaining diff is the same brand/padding geometry gap as navbar--basic.

cells.label: first active
cells.note: styled TabPanel adds 1rem 0 padding; Bootstrap .tab-pane has none → panel content sits ~1rem lower. Tab buttons themselves mirror nav-tabs closely.

cells.label: sm
cells.note: Bootstrap sizes the group via .btn-group-sm>.btn tokens; styled resizes children with a doubled-specificity rule.

cells.label: contextual variants
cells.note: contextual items remap --bs-list-group-* to the color -subtle/-emphasis tokens (styled reads runtime --bs-* var, falls back to 5.3.8 default).

cells.label: glow (frozen frame)
cells.note: animation frozen by the harness → glow rests at base opacity 0.5 on both sides.

cells.label: shown (header+body+close)
cells.note: close button: Bootstrap btn-close is an SVG background-image; styled CloseButton renders a × glyph (same pre-existing CloseButton gap).

cells.label: container top-end
cells.note: container placed absolutely inside a relative box (viewport-fixed placement escapes the per-cell capture); styled position="top-end" overridden to absolute to match .position-absolute utilities.

cells.label: list-group (activeId)
cells.note: Bootstrap scrollspy list-group uses .list-group-item-action (gray link color); ScrollspyNav renders plain body-color list items — a real minor color gap.

cells.label: slide 1 (indicators+controls+caption)
cells.note: control icons are the verbatim 5.3.8 SVG data-URIs; caption h5/p use default browser margins (styled side has no Reboot reset).

cells.label: hover (static, at rest)
cells.note: hover accent only appears on :hover; captured statically at rest → both sides render the base table.

cells.label: dark + striped (emphasis-rgb fix)
cells.note: exercises the dark-mode striping fix: --bs-emphasis-color-rgb now emits 255,255,255 under [data-bs-theme=dark] so the striped accent matches the oracle.

cells.label: <Box m={3} p={2} d="flex" bg="primary"/> → m-3 p-2 d-flex bg-primary
cells.note: utility CSS scoped inline (verbatim oracle rules); class-map pixel check

cells.label: <Box p={3} bg="success" rounded/> → p-3 bg-success rounded
cells.note: utility CSS scoped inline (verbatim oracle rules); class-map pixel check

cells.label: shown (header/body/footer + backdrop)
cells.note: native = static .modal.show + .modal-backdrop.show; clip captures dialog box + shadow over the 50% backdrop.

cells.label: shown from start (+ backdrop)
cells.note: native = static .offcanvas.offcanvas-start.show + backdrop; panel spans the left edge, clip clamped to viewport.

cells.label: menu open (items + divider)
cells.note: native = static .dropdown-menu.show; default dropdown menu carries no box-shadow.

cells.label: shown top (arrow)
cells.note: native = static .tooltip.show.bs-tooltip-top; .tooltip carries opacity 0.9 incl. arrow.

cells.label: shown top (title + body + arrow)
cells.note: native = static .popover.bs-popover-top; two-layer arrow (::before border + ::after fill).
